vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Ada was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Mpumelelo taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Mpumelelo passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Cheyenne, Ada and Mpumelelo met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Cheyenne, Ada, Mpumelelo are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Ada, Ebrahim, Oliver, Henry and Elena met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Ada, Ebrahim, Henry, Elena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ada, Oliver, Henry and Elena met them at the door — 4 put down. Oliver, Henry are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ada just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ada, Ebrahim, Oliver, Henry and Devon met them at the door — 5 put down. Ada, Ebrahim, Oliver, Henry, Devon are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ada just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ebrahim just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ada, Ebrahim, Oliver, Henry and Elena met them at the door — 5 put down. Ada, Ebrahim, Oliver, Elena are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nikolai met them at the door — 1 put down. Nikolai is hurt.
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Ebrahim showed Henry the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

Ada: "Deeqa and Ebrahim blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 5 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Deeqa just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Deeqa just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Deeqa met them at the door — 1 put down. Deeqa is hurt.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
